about_the_game:
Yellowcake is an audio game. This means that the entire world and story are told in sound. To navigate in this game, you will need headphones or some other kind of audio device that allows you to localize sounds. Close your eyes and dive into a world like no other!

Yellowcake is a first-person experience. You play as Vident, a young man with a special gift. He can hear objects, animals and humans - but not just in the ordinary way. Vident can hear people even if they stand perfectly still and hold their breath. And he can hear the rocky walls of the uranium mines, in which he lives and works - and whose secrets he will soon discover. This talent helps him navigate through twisty caves and sneak past guards who try to stop him.

Yellowcake and this demo are suitable for sightless and visually impaired players, but a narrated menu is not yet implemented.

content_descriptors.notes: Player character is audibly (but not visibly) punched and knocked out when caught by an enemy. A distant "war zone" is audible. This includes detonations, but not screams or gory sounds. Player character can be hit by fast moving mine carts. The resulting sound and context indicate that the player character is likely killed, even though no explicitly gory sound is audible.

name: Yellowcake - The Audio Game Demo
short_description: A first-person audio game, telling the tale of a blind yet gifted hero. Make your way through a 3D environment without receiving any visual cues. The demo contains the first two chapters of the upcoming 5-chapter journey. Optimised for headphones.
